official_site_checks: Fixtures verify that gallery chapter records always start at /view/<gallery>/1/, avoiding arbitrary page links from gallery thumbnails and that reader image manifests yield ordered, validated page requests. Version 22 maps a single known gallery language tag to the chapter's BCP 47 language code; translated-only, unrecognized and mixed-language entries are left unset. A live gallery inspected on 2026-09-25 exposes its language tags under Languages: (for example, french), which grounds the parser; device rendering remains unverified. Dynamic listings expose six category and seven language browse feeds through the existing filtered search route; fixtures verify exact flag selection, pagination and rejection of unknown IDs. Version 19 marks completed, one-gallery manga as UpdateStrategy::Never through search, detail and update paths. Version 20 adds a mobile Safari User-Agent and matching gallery-page Referer to reader HTML and CDN image requests. Version 21 applies those browser headers to Home, search, listings, gallery details and reader HTML. Device rendering remains unverified. A fresh official /gallery/ page fetched on 2026-09-25 contains a hidden li.posted label such as Posted: 8 hours ago and no machine-readable upload timestamp. Version 24 converts supported relative age labels to an approximate Chapter.date_uploaded timestamp at fetch time; unsupported labels remain unset. Fixtures cover supported units, malformed values and chapter integration.
